scope: Read-only audit of committed P1 evidence and official platform documentation; no account, resource, deployment, API call, or fee was created.

candidates.name: GitHub Pages
candidates.reason: Public repository already exists; static evidence needs no backend, model key, Qdrant, or runtime compute.
verified_facts: GitHub Free supports Pages for public repositories.
Published site size limit is 1 GB.
100 GB per month bandwidth and 10 builds per hour are soft limits.

candidates.name: Google Cloud Run
candidates.reason: Container, secret, scale-to-zero, memory, concurrency, and maximum-instance controls fit the existing API shape, but cost and resource behavior require measurement.
verified_facts: Default memory is 512 MiB and configurable memory limits are supported.
Concurrency and maximum instance counts are configurable.
Maximum instances can be briefly exceeded in some circumstances.
Cloud Billing budgets provide alerts and are not hard spending caps.

candidates.name: Qdrant Cloud
candidates.reason: The current point count fits the documented prototype free-cluster envelope, but inactivity lifecycle and migration recovery must be tested.
verified_facts: Documented free cluster: one node, 1 GB RAM, 0.5 vCPU, and 4 GB disk.
The free cluster does not require a credit card.
Inactive free clusters can be suspended and later deleted under the documented lifecycle.

candidates.name: Hugging Face Spaces
candidates.reason: Resource shape may fit, but plan, visibility, sleep, and non-persistent storage constraints add account-dependent assumptions.

candidates.name: Render Free
candidates.reason: The documented free 0.1 CPU and 512 MB service has not been shown to fit the local embedding workload; filesystem is ephemeral and services sleep.

candidates.name: Fly.io
candidates.reason: No free tier and a payment method is required while the project budget remains unknown.

decision.conditional_live_stack: Google Cloud Run plus Qdrant Cloud
